title: Bind R439 interleaved COPY to ideal whole-call hosting
body:
PR2407 changes the ADD chronology inside a live COPY window, while PR1627's retained certificate is bound to the old PR589 program. This package binds PR2407's exact 13,990-record word to the existing whole-call proof in its **ideal finite-orthogonal-field stream model**. Only the two local programs, source-record hash and per-call program hashes change; all 288 owner descriptors and the global paid profile remain fixed.

The result closes the ideal snapshot/owner part of PR2421's handoff. It is an applicability certificate, not a new generic theorem, native replay, physical compiler or kappa claim.

- Both orientations cover all 661 arbitrary dirty-input columns and 636 exact rational frame projectors. The live window contains 303 target-to-target ADDs and ten snapshot taps, with no source/slot writes or interior address child.
- All 288 owner descriptors and 126,432 helper occurrences are checked. Rank mass 1,808,352, deficit 10,272 and nine reserved private families remain unchanged.
- Eight semantic controls, an accepted equivalent tap order, and six behavioral test groups include actual guard removal and a read-only Git-free replay. A separate mathematical reviewer checked the reverse translation and whole-call implication.

## Evidence and validation

Package: `research/r439-interleaved-copy-contract/`. Start with `README.md`, `REVIEW.md` and `RESULT.json`; `PREDECESSOR.json` and `SOURCES.json` pin exact source bytes. `VALIDATION.json` records local evidence.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-interleaved-copy-contract
make selected-record-check
```

Both pass locally on CPython 3.12.12. The registered replay runs the checker and six test groups under isolated optimized Python. The selected-record check is not a cold supplier replay; hosted CI is separate.

Credit alephnan's PR1627 and cheesegrader's PR540 for the generic argument, Ross Richardson's PR2407 construction, starship-s's PR2421 native replay, Jose Manuel's PR2195 packet boundary, Adam Gall's adjacent PR2088 two-snapshot work, and the retained supplier/exporter lineage. PR2407's constructor and PR1627's exact engines are explicitly reused, not presented as independent implementations.

Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Submission overlap refreshed all 635 open PRs including drafts and 1,167 Discussion records with complete pagination; the report's closed-PR/diff limits remain explicit in `TASK.json`. [Canonical finding and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2401#discussioncomment-18945668).

## Remaining obligations

Complete local-ring packet admission, concrete compiler/scratch allocation, and the full routing, recursive-work, tape and precision invoice remain open. The package gives two concrete next questions. No selected-frontier edit, new kappa, human review or formal-kernel proof is claimed.

Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate recursive-interface review agent. New work is Apache-2.0; inherited source notices are retained.
